FM04.reasoning: The agent computes the median for latitude and longitude imputation over the concatenated train and test dataset before splitting, leaking test set distribution statistics into the training data.

FM15.reasoning: The agent evaluates and reports only the RMSE metric, without verifying if it fully captures model performance or checking alternatives like MAE which might be more robust to depth outliers.

other_failure_modes.name: Leakage via global frequency encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Computing category frequencies on the concatenated train and test datasets leaks the test set's categorical distribution into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a sophisticated solution featuring spatial feature engineering (KNN-based target encoding), diverse gradient boosting models, and optimized ensemble stacking. However, the solution suffers from data leakage due to calculating imputation medians and category frequencies on the combined train and test sets prior to modeling. Furthermore, it relies solely on a single evaluation metric (RMSE).
